basis: Adopted 2026-10-29 08:20 from docs/proposals/shape-rules-v3-loso.md: landers/shape_v2.json with tile_top withdrawn. The leave-one-site-out check (out/loso/shape_v2/loso_shape_v2.json, scripts/loso.py) showed every rule's lift holds on sites it was not fitted on, and that tile_top's pass fraction is a property of the ground (0.006 to 0.454 by strip, over the 5 percent bar on five of eight strips), so what it rewards changes with the terrain. Withdrawing it leaves the key at 8 of 18 (hardware 7 of 12) and moves injection hardware from 35 to 32 of 72, fabric from 9 to 10 of 24. The three remaining rules are physical tests with stable pass fractions. Re-measure and re-version whenever the detector changes.

rules.name: saturated
rules.basis: landers/shape_v1.json: at least one pixel at the sensor's saturation; natural ground at HiRISE exposure rarely saturates, bright hardware often does

rules.name: shadow_strong
rules.basis: dark on the anti-sun side only, far beyond what polygon troughs and slopes produce, with a length that reads as a 0.5 to 3 m object; bright branch only, the shadow branch already selects on this

rules.name: dark_shadow
rules.basis: a dark object that still casts a shadow of the right length stands above the ground; a dark patch in the ground does not
